# pve_ha_group (Data Source)

Reads a single HA group from `GET /cluster/ha/groups/{group}`. PVE marks HA groups as deprecated in favor of HA rules (`pve_ha_rule`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_ha_group" "primary" {
  group = "primary"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group` (String) The HA group identifier to look up.

### Read-Only

- `comment` (String) Description of the HA group.
- `nodes` (List of String) Cluster node members as `<node>` or `<node>:<priority>` entries.
- `nofailback` (Boolean) Whether automatic failback to the highest-priority node is disabled.
- `restricted` (Boolean) Whether resources bound to the group may only run on the group's nodes.
